core_exact_definitions.exact_schema:
structure SourceAnchor where
  key : String
  kind : SourceKind
  pathOrUrl : String
  label : String
  note : String
deriving Repr, DecidableEq
core_exact_definitions.name: SourceAnchor

core_exact_definitions.exact_schema:
structure ProofObligation where
  id : String
  statement : String
  source : SourceAnchor
  status : ProofStatus := ProofStatus.obligation
  dependsOn : List String := []
  note : String := ""
deriving Repr, DecidableEq
core_exact_definitions.name: ProofObligation

core_exact_definitions.exact_schema:
structure TheoremContract where
  id : String
  title : String
  mode : String
  source : SourceAnchor
  targetLean : String
  statementSummary : String
  proofStatus : ProofStatus := ProofStatus.contractOnly
  obligations : List ProofObligation := []
deriving Repr, DecidableEq
core_exact_definitions.name: TheoremContract

core_exact_definitions.exact_schema:
structure ProofDagBlock where
  id : String
  interface : String
  source : SourceAnchor
  targetLean : String
  dependsOn : List String := []
  reusedBy : List String := []
  status : ProofStatus := ProofStatus.planned
deriving Repr, DecidableEq
core_exact_definitions.name: ProofDagBlock

core_exact_definitions.exact_schema:
inductive ProofStatus where
  | planned
  | sourceCited
  | contractOnly
  | obligation
  | formalized
  | blocked
deriving Repr, DecidableEq
core_exact_definitions.name: ProofStatus

core_exact_definitions.exact_schema:
inductive SourceKind where
  | paper
  | localTex
  | externalLean
  | mathlib
  | citedResult
  | experimentNote
deriving Repr, DecidableEq
core_exact_definitions.name: SourceKind

SourceAnchor.kind_of_object: Provenance pointer, not a mathematical statement or certificate.
SourceAnchor.key: Stable source/group identifier; multiple anchors may share it.
SourceAnchor.pathOrUrl: Recorded location string; may be a local source path, package path, or URL. Existence and revision are not certified by the field.
SourceAnchor.label: Recorded equation/theorem/proof label or declaration/search target. It may be composite or descriptive, not necessarily a resolvable Lean declaration.
SourceAnchor.note: Human-authored scope, line-range, reuse, or caveat text. It is stored prose, not a checked assertion.

ProofObligation.kind_of_object: Record of an unproved requirement or bounded outstanding workflow item.
ProofObligation.statement: Desired mathematical or workflow content as String; it is not a proposition in Prop and the def does not prove it.
ProofObligation.status: Stored ProofStatus, default obligation; even an explicitly stored formalized does not independently certify a Lean theorem.
ProofObligation.dependsOn: List of declared dependency names as strings; may mix theorem names, obligations, source labels, or descriptions. Not the compiled dependency DAG.
ProofObligation.note: Recorded evidence/caveats; may distinguish a compiled scalar helper from still-open source analysis.

TheoremContract.kind_of_object: A Lean-facing paper-theorem specification, not the theorem's proof.
TheoremContract.title: Human-readable intended theorem/lemma title.
TheoremContract.mode: Workflow mode as String, not a theorem assumption.
TheoremContract.targetLean: Target Lean file/name as recorded text, not a declaration reference with type checking.
TheoremContract.statementSummary: Prose summary of intended content; no Prop is proved by this field.
TheoremContract.obligations: List of ProofObligation data attached to the contract; defaults to empty, which does not certify completeness.

ProofDagBlock.kind_of_object: Declared proof-plan/reuse node, not an emitted compiled proof edge.
ProofDagBlock.dependsOn: Declared input names as strings, default empty.
ProofDagBlock.reusedBy: Declared consumers as strings, default empty.

ProofStatus.kind_of_object: A six-constructor enum used in workflow records. None carries a proof term.
ProofStatus.sourceCited: Recorded source citation without local proof certification.
ProofStatus.formalized: The record claims formalized status; the renderer must not upgrade actual proof/assimilation status from this enum alone.

local_schema_fields.String: Descriptive text even when field names say formula, theorem, inequality, derivative, source gap, or proof.
local_schema_fields.List String: Ordered descriptive/naming checklist, not logical conjunction or compiler dependency list.
local_schema_fields.ProofStatus: Stored workflow tag; honor the exact default but do not infer mathematical certification.
